result.reason: The added operative insurance covenant meets every preferred requirement, so it necessarily also meets the lower fallback E&O and cyber limits. It leaves the existing force-majeure provision unchanged and adds no unrelated insurance obligations. The insurance language is clear, but the rendered clause retains the pre-existing apparent typo "reasonable control or TrueLink," materially reducing overall drafting quality.
